title: Sharp Spanning Multiplicity, Exact Characteristic Threshold for Polynomial Multiplication Log-Star-Convexity, and Unbounded Non-Crossing Subadditivity Gaps in the Asymptotic Spectrum of Tensors
abstract: Vrana and Zuiddam (arXiv:2611.34664v1, 2026) proved that the asymptotic spectrum Delta of complex k-tensors is path-connected and contractible, established log-star-convexity for polynomial multiplication tensors pi P_{m,n} over C via compact SU(2) Haar averaging, extended log-star-convexity for matrix multiplication and graph tensors to arbitrary fields via finite spanning groups, and exhibited a single 5-tensor counterexample on C^2 showing that geometric averages of non-crossing bipartition flattening ranks need not be B-good. We establish three sharp quantitative and structural strengthenings. First (Theorem 1), we replace their real-valued subspace-intersection bound q_VZ(d,w) = (d/(d-w))(1 + ln d) (Lemma 3.7) with the exact integer-floor greedy recurrence u_{j+1} = floor((w/d) u_j), proving q_exact(d,w) <= min_{0<=t<=d}(t + floor(d(w/d)^t)) <= d strictly beats q_VZ for every d >= 2 and 1 <= w <= d - 1, eliminates the unbounded ln d blowup at codimension r = 1 (where q_exact(d,d-1) = d is unconditionally optimal by codimension submodularity, saving 7.93x at d = 1024), and tightens finite-copy reverse monotonicity (Lemmas 3.8 and 4.3). Second (Theorem 2), we extend polynomial-multiplication log-star-convexity (Theorem 3.12) to every field F of positive characteristic p > max_j(m_j + n_j - 2) using only the finite group SL_2(F_p) via constructive Vandermonde matrix-unit extraction B_1^{k-i}(A_k B_k)A_1^{k-j} = (k!/i!)(k-j)! E_{i,j} paired with Corollary 4.7; conversely, we prove via a constructive Diophantine impossibility theorem that for every nontrivial P_{m,n} (m, n >= 2), all three legs are GL_2(F-bar)-irreducible if and only if p > m + n - 2, yielding the exact closed spectrum Delta_F(P_{m,n}) = [min(m,n), m + n - 1] whenever |F| >= m + n - 2 and char(F) not in {2, ..., m + n - 2}. Third (Theorem 3), we generalize Example 6.2 (d = 2, S_3, ratio 3/(2 sqrt(2))) to an explicit S_{d+1}-invariant 5-tensor family a^(d) = a_1^(d) + a_2^(d) in B for every d >= 2 with exact flattening ranks (1,d), (d,1), (d+1,d+1), proving w_theta(a^(d))/(w_theta(a_1^(d)) + w_theta(a_2^(d))) = (d+1)/(d^t + d^{1-t}) > 1 for every strictly interior weight t in (0, 1) and unbounded growth ~ (1/2) sqrt(d) -> infinity (valid over every field with char(F) not dividing d + 1); and we upgrade qualitative path continuity (Theorem 2.10(v)) to sharp quantitative directional Lipschitz regularity of t -> log F_t(s) on [delta, 1 - delta], illustrated by the exact W-state strict Jensen defect (5/3) ln 2 - ln 3 (3^3 = 27 < 32 = 2^5). All results are backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates, and 56 adversarial tests.
